title: bath rugs
text: bath rugs. I purchased 4, 2 smaller, 2 large.  First the color - I chose the taupe gray.  It is exactly as described - browner than gray - but not at all like the photo.  The photo looks much more gray.  I actually needed a taupe so I rolled the dice.  Turned out right for me.  Second, the material of the mat. The nap is very - how shall I describe it - furry.  It is not a loop carpet.  The fibers are a bit frayed at the ends so it ends up feeling and looking a tad furry. Plus the strands are a bit longer - adding to the fur like look.  I am still on the fence of the look of that - but I could see how those things may make the fibers more absorbent. We shall see.  I am hoping they don't crush too easily and recover after each use.  It is rubber backed (they note on the tag that you want to be sure not to have water underneath the rug as it could "slide on the water" Hmmm - I'll watch out for that - but it IS a bathroom rug - with water.)  They did wash up in the washing machine (I used the delicate cycle) and low temp in the tumble portion of my dryer closet.  No issues and very little lent - again, a bit of furry like fuzz.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
